Select compound_chembl_id, canonical_smiles, compound_key, pubmed_id_or_doi, assay_description, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units, activity_comment, target_chembl_id, target_name, target_organism. Source molecule_hierarchy, molecule_dictionary, compound_structures, compound_records, docs, activities, assays, target_dictionary. Join molecule_hierarchy to molecule_dictionary on parent_molregno to get parent CHEMBL3182437, then join child molecules via molregno. Join compound_structures on molregno. Join compound_records on molregno. Join activities on record_id. Join docs on doc_id. Join assays on assay_id. Join target_dictionary on tid. Filter parent CHEMBL3182437, target CHEMBL3430885, standard_type IC50. Sort by compound_chembl_id, canonical_smiles, compound_key, pubmed_id_or_doi, assay_description, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units, activity_comment, target_chembl_id, target_name, target_organism.
